card.name: The name Ian and similar name parts
card.fires_on: The first name Ian (also the ending of names like Lucian), and a few similar name pieces such as Yan, Yen, Xun and Liz, in general web text about people.

modes.description: The name Ian written as a person's given name before a surname.

modes.label: Ending of a name
modes.description: The last part of a longer personal or place name, often Chinese or classical.
